newsitem.title: USA: TJX CFO sees European expansion from UK.
newsitem.headline: TJX CFO sees European expansion from UK.

text.p: TJX Cos Chief Financial Officer Donald Campbell said on Tuesday its 18 T.K. Maxx outlets in Britain were performing smartly and the the company will export its U.S. style discount retailing aimed at middle-class and upper middle-class bargain hunters to elsewhere in Europe..
"It won't be Germany and it won't be France, but it won't be very far from Britain," Campbell said, in response to a question at an investors conference sponsored by Robert James & Associates Inc.

He declined to identify which country or countries the company was eyeing but said Europe was a very promising market for TJX, a specialist in selling products commonly found in high-end department stores at sharp discounts in stripped-down outlets.
It dominates the so-called off- price segment in the United States, with 1,075 stores. It also operates 65 off-price outlets in Canada.
Campbell gave no timetable for the expansion.
